segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: Mr. Chair, distinguished colleagues, good afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: Allow this representation to first acknowledge the presence of the Secretary of Foreign Affairs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: the Honorable Maria Teresa Lazaro, a career diplomat of over four decades, whose steady

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: hand has served this Republic from the halls of ASEAN to the capitals of Europe, and now

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: at the helm of our entire Foreign Service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: With her are the Undersecretaries and Assistant Secretaries of the Department, the leadership

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: of the Foreign Service Institute, the UNESCO National Commission of the Philippines, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: the Presidential Commission on Visiting Forces, and the men and women of our Foreign Service,

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: many of whom serve quietly, far from home, so that no Filipino abroad ever has to stand

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: alone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: We welcome you all to the House of the People.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: Mr. Chair, it is the distinct honor of this representation to co-sponsor the proposed

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Foreign Affairs and its attached agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: in the amount of 35 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: Diplomacy is our first line of defense, long before any show of force is ever contemplated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: It is the diplomat who stands for the flag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: At the negotiating table, in the consular window, at the side of a distressed kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: seeking help in foreign soil.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: When we fund the DFA, we fund the peaceful assertion of who we are as a nation, the protection

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: of our national interests, the promotion of the welfare and dignity of every Filipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: overseas, the pursuit of economic opportunity through our partnerships abroad, and the projection

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: of the best that the Filipino has to offer to the world.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: These are the pillars of our nation's foreign policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: This budget is their foundation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: On that score, the department has earned this chamber's confidence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: The 2025 annual performance review shows every indicator met or exceeded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: On the consular side, the part our constituents feel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: Ninety-nine percent of cases involving overseas Filipinos were acted upon with the prescribed

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: period.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: All other consular documents were issued on time, and another 99 percent of passports

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: were released within the prescribed period.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: These are not abstractions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: behind each percentage point is a filipino whose government answered when it mattered

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: will continue to bring its services closer to every filipino whether at home or abroad

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: mr chair the mandate of the department is to promote and protect philippine interests in

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza

segments.speaker: Rep. Niko Raul S.J. Daza
segments.text: may be in the world, their government stands with them. Saan man sila sa mundo, hindi sila nag-iisa.

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar
segments.text: of the continental shelf at UN headquarters in New York.

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar
segments.text: Next slide, please. The Philippines also, sorry, the DFA also led in preparations for the

segments.speaker: DFA Assistant Secretary Robespierre L. Bolivar
